title: Human-Robot Interactions in Investment Decisions
near_miss_reason: Staggered individual take-up of a robo-advisor in French employee saving plans (monthly panel Jan 2016-Jun 2021; individual-by-saving-vehicle units, takers vs. 'curious' non-takers), reghdfe y robo_treated*after + controls, absorb(saving-vehicle or individual FE, month FE), two-way clustered. Every main-text column includes time-varying controls (variable remuneration received in t and t-1, yearly remuneration, and in most columns lagged log account value, past 12-month equity share and past return). Tables 2, 4, 5 and 7 (and the Figure 1 event studies) have controls as the sole violation; Table 3 adds alert regressors (extra treatment terms), Table 6 has no unit FE, Table A4 is IV.
near_miss_5c_note: 5c-eligible on design (Tables 2, 4, 5, 7; Figure 1), but excluded because the data are confidential and not shipped (CASCAD on-site verification only).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Take-up dates vary by individual (Figure 1 event time is relative to each investor's subscription month); cannot be counted without data.
never_treated_note: 'Curious' investors who never subscribed serve as controls (Table 7 uses exposed non-takers and non-exposed investors).
eligible_reason: Staggered robo-advisor take-up with unit and month FE, but every main-text column includes time-varying controls (remuneration in t and t-1, yearly remuneration; lagged account value and past equity share/return in most), so no column satisfies every rule. Data are confidential (on-site access at the asset manager) and not shipped.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. Table 2: attention (connections per month, individual FE) and trades (total, robo, individual; saving-vehicle FE). Table 3: alerts and rebalancing (robo x alert and alert regressors). Tables 4-5: equity share and realized/expected returns (Table 5 restricts controls to 'curious close' investors). Table 6: cross-sectional probit-like LPMs with month FE only. Table 7: alternative control groups. Figure 1: event studies b6..b1, p0..p5 plus a 'rest' bin, with the same controls. Table A4: IV with share of colleagues using the robo.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls in every column (sole violation; 5c design-eligible)
specs.outcome: i_nbconnect_month, i_nbarb_disp, i_nbarb_divep_ex0_disp, i_nbarb_libreauto_disp, i_equityshare, i_ret_disp_real, i_ret_disp_exp
specs.treatment_var: i_dum_aftsubscrib_firmdisp (robo treated x after; i_dum_aftsubscrib at individual level)
specs.unit_var: paneldisp (individual x saving vehicle) or panelind (individual)
specs.reported_location: Table 2 cols 1-6; Table 4 cols 1-5; Table 5 cols 1-5; Table 7; Figure 1
specs.notes: Controls vary by column: Table 4 cols 1, 2, 4 use only remuneration controls (i_amountrem_year, i_dum_receiverem_bef1, i_dum_receiverem); cols 3, 5 add past equity share.

specs.exclusion_reason: extra treatment regressors (robo x alert, alert counts) plus controls
Table 6 cross-sectional (no unit FE); Table A4 IV (appendix)

data_files_note: Only dorobo.do, a variable list and CASCAD certificate/execution report are shipped; employee-saving-plan data are confidential and accessible only on a dedicated machine at the asset manager.
data_provenance_note: CASCAD verified reproduction on-site via screen share (April 2024); no data in the package.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Near-miss with controls as the sole violation in several main tables, but no shipped data.
